correctness.rationale: The gcd matrix is exactly cI+b(I_p tensor J_p)+J, with c=pb. Integral difference coordinates split p(p−2) scalar factors. A unimodular simultaneous basis change conjugates the rank-one all-ones operator into a fixed 2×2 form plus zeros, reducing to p−2 copies of B_p and one K_p. The 2×2 block has determinantal divisors b, 2p²b²; pivoting 1 in K leaves b times T_p, whose gcd entries is 1, gcd 2×2 minors is p², and determinant 2p⁴(3p−2). The assembled factors divide sequentially for all primes including p=2. Exact checker replays small matrices and prime-specific blocks; universal proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: The gcd-difference circulant is a canonical number-theoretic convolution; p² is the first prime-power level with two distinct nontrivial congruence classes in the kernel. Complete integral cokernel structure for an infinite family of growing matrices is not given by Fourier eigenvalues. The small-core decomposition identifies precisely which torsion factors are exceptional, enabling natural higher-prime-power investigations without claiming them.
